description: Selected for a Software Engineer Internship at PayPal, scheduled to begin in May. Will be working on production-grade systems alongside experienced engineers, contributing to feature development, code quality, and performance improvements while following industry-standard engineering practices.

Working as a React and Node.js Developer on production-level web applications. Responsible for building and maintaining scalable frontend interfaces using React, and developing backend APIs using Node.js. Actively involved in integrating frontend with backend services, handling application state, implementing authentication flows, and improving overall performance and user experience. Collaborate with designers and developers to deliver features aligned with business requirements and timelines.

Worked as a Frontend-focused SDE Intern, developing and maintaining user-facing features for web applications. Built reusable React components, implemented responsive UI designs, and integrated frontend logic with existing APIs. Collaborated with the development team to translate design requirements into functional interfaces, fix UI bugs, and improve overall user experience. Followed best practices for clean code, component structure, and version control.

Worked independently with small businesses, startups, and individuals to design and develop responsive, high-performance websites. Delivered end-to-end solutions including UI development, WordPress customization, backend integration, performance optimization, and deployment. Collaborated directly with clients to understand requirements, propose solutions, and deliver projects on time with clear communication and revisions. Also handled website maintenance, bug fixes, and feature enhancements post-delivery.
